_help: Editor's picks shown at the top of the site. Add an object per pick: title, url, source, date (YYYY-MM-DD), note (one line on why it matters, in your own words). Picks drop off after expires_days (default 30). Use clean publisher URLs, no tracking tags.

picks.title: Google Flow adds Pocket Studio: new camera angles generated from one phone take
picks.note: Google says the tool generates extra camera angles from a single take and keeps the actor's performance intact. That is Google's claim, not an independent test. For Editors it raises questions about coverage and what counts as footage.

picks.title: Canada's CBC Joins Global Microdrama Boom
picks.note: Vertical, short-form drama is arriving in Canada. Faster schedules and lean crews will change how post gets booked and paid.

picks.title: Big tech sent a wish list to U.S. trade negotiators. Here are the Canadian policies they want scrapped
picks.note: The rules that fund Canadian content are on the table in trade talks. That money is what keeps Canadian shows in post here.

picks.title: Budget 2026 strengthens news funding, cuts CBC dollars, and leaves CanCon hanging
picks.note: What the federal budget means for the broadcasters and funders that commission Canadian screen work.

picks.title: It's up to Carney to protect Canadian content on our screens
picks.note: An opinion piece on whether Canadian-content protections survive the pressure from Washington.

picks.title: Everybody's macrodosing on microdramas
picks.note: Background on the microdrama phenomenon behind the shift in what gets made and where it's watched.

picks.title: DaVinci Resolve 21.1 Uses MCP to Let AI Assistants Control the Edit
picks.note: Resolve Studio now has a built-in MCP server, so an AI assistant can handle routine edit-room jobs like renaming clips, building deliverables and reframing to vertical from plain-language instructions.

picks.title: Disney's Accelerator Day Highlights AI Startups
picks.note: Disney is putting money behind AI startups, including ones building hybrid filmmaking tools, and says it wants artists involved at every step of the workflow.

picks.title: Disney Taps Adobe as 'Official AI Innovation Partner' Under Multiyear Pact
picks.note: Adobe, maker of Premiere Pro and After Effects, becomes Disney's AI partner in a multiyear alliance. Expect AI features to keep showing up in the tools editors already use.

bodies.title: CMPA celebrates federal government's significant investment in Canadian culture
bodies.note: The CMPA's response to the federal budget: $600 million in immediate support for cultural industries and $300 million over two years for CBC/Radio-Canada.

bodies.title: CEPI welcomes CMPA and AQPM as its first international observer members
bodies.note: Canadian independent producers' associations join the European producers' association CEPI as observers.

bodies.title: CMPA appoints three new Board Directors on eve of federal advocacy meetings
bodies.note: New directors, plus polling the CMPA took to Ottawa on the Online Streaming Act.

bodies.title: Global screen sector coalition calls on governments to protect local content
bodies.note: A joint statement from 23 screen organizations, released at TIFF, backing domestic production requirements.

bodies.title: KOTV, Tyler Hagan, and Anthony Cauchy named 2026 CMPA Indiescreen Awards winners
bodies.note: The producers honoured at the Indiescreen Awards during TIFF.

bodies.title: Avid accelerates music creation and audio post production with new Pro Tools Extensions and AI-powered capabilities
bodies.note: Pro Tools 2026.11 adds Extensions (a new plugin format), an AI Stem Separator that runs locally, MIDI Polyphonic Expression and sharper Windows displays.

bodies.title: What's new in Avid Media Composer 2026.8
bodies.note: Multicam Auto Cut driven by speaker, better transcript tools, an OpenTimelineIO 2.0 adapter update and secure collaboration on shared storage with Media Composer Enterprise.

bodies.title: Avid shows the future of agentic editing at IBC2026, launches Media Composer 2026.8
bodies.note: The press release behind the 2026.8 launch, with Avid's agentic editing preview and browser-based editing.

bodies.title: Canada wants its content seen. Who is investing in making audiences care?
bodies.note: Argues Canada funds production far more than marketing and audience-building, citing a January 2026 CRTC-commissioned study, and calls for a national audience-development strategy.
